headline: Son Pham reports ARC-AGI-3 scoring blackout: teams flying blind

image.alt: AI editorial cartoon: five spider mascots, two rabbits, the seven-character Turducken crew with two Yorkies, and rival engineers gather with lanterns beneath an unlit scoreboard.
image.caption: Lights Out at the Scoring Hall.

sections.heading: Breaking tip — more details to follow
sections.text: Son Pham reports zero scores from ARC-AGI-3 notebook runs and says competitors are relying on local estimates while waiting for answers. In a message this evening, he described a scoring “blackout” and said there had been no official answers from Kaggle. This is an initial participant report: the scope and cause have not been independently established. Pham plans to post a Kaggle discussion. Additional details to follow.
